extensionDescription.message: AI-powered instant speech translation for all video meetings. Break language barriers with real-time voice translation.

clickToStart.message: Click "Open GM MeetMind" below to start real-time translation.

quickStartInstructions.message: Configure your API key (OpenAI or Gemini) → Select "Sokuji_Virtual_Mic" as microphone → Start speaking!

gatherTownGuidance.message: Za korištenje GM MeetMindja, odaberite "GM MeetMind Virtual Microphone" u postavkama mikrofona.

wherebyGuidance.message: Za korištenje GM MeetMind, molimo odaberite "GM MeetMind Virtual Microphone" u postavkama mikrofona i onemogućite smanjenje buke za bolje performanse.

defaultGuidance.message: To use GM MeetMind, please select "GM MeetMind Virtual Microphone" in your microphone settings.

discordGuidance.message: To use GM MeetMind, please select "GM MeetMind Virtual Microphone" in your microphone settings and disable Noise Suppression in Discord's Voice settings for better performance.

slackGuidance.message: To use GM MeetMind in Slack Huddles, please start a Huddle, then select "GM MeetMind Virtual Microphone" in your Video and Mic settings, and disable Noise Suppression in Audio & Video preferences for better performance.

teamsGuidance.message:
Ako ne vidite potpuni popis audio uređaja u postavkama Teamsa:
1) Privremeno onemogućite GM MeetMind proširenje i osvježite stranicu
2) Dozvolite Teamsu pristup mikrofonu i kameri kada budete upitani
3) Ponovo omogućite GM MeetMind proširenje i osvježite stranicu ponovno
4) Dozvolite GM MeetMindju pristup mikrofonu kada budete upitani. Sada biste trebali vidjeti i stvarne uređaje i "GM MeetMind Virtual Microphone" u postavkama.

jitsiGuidance.message: Za korištenje GM MeetMind u Jitsi Meet, otvorite Settings > Devices i odaberite "GM MeetMind Virtual Microphone" kao svoj mikrofon. Zatim otvorite Advanced audio settings i onemogućite Noise suppression, Echo cancellation i Automatic gain control za jasan prevedeni zvuk.

unsupportedHeadline.message: GM MeetMind još nije dostupan na $HOSTNAME$.

desktopCtaBody.message: Sistemski virtualni mikrofon za OBS, YouTube, Twitch i bilo koju desktop aplikaciju. Windows · macOS · Linux.

browserSitesHeading.message: Više volite preglednik? GM MeetMind radi na ovim stranicama — kliknite za otvaranje:

detectFailBody.message: Osvježite stranicu i ponovo otvorite GM MeetMind.
